WHEREAS, there exist Transferred Development Rights (hereinafter defined),which are appurtenant to the Owner's Premises, which are in excess of the Development Rights utilized by the Owner's Improvements and the same are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution. As used in this Agreement, the term"Transferred Development Rights"shall mean the 12,000.00 square feet of the Development Rights not in use by the Owner's Premises. The term “Development Rights” shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting or adding thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the floor area ratio established for structures in the zoning district or districts in which the zoning lot is located, (i) the inclusion of any bonus floor area available to the zoning lot pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and (i) thefurther inclusion of any use, bulk, density, and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of from time to time; and WHEREAS, Owner and Developer desire to set forth the rights and obligations of each with respect to development and certain related activities on their respective portions of the singlezoninglot tobe created simultaneouslyherewith.
